value: Raw phone sensor data and logs, downloadable by researchers through the web download page, the Data Download API or Mano. Streams: accelerometer, gyroscope, GPS (optional fuzzing), screen and power state, identifiers, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, call and text logs (Android only), proximity, magnetometer, device motion and reachability (iOS only), plus surveys and audio-survey recordings. Android also has an optional ambient (continuous) audio stream, off by default and set per study. Call and text logs come only from the lab-distributed Android builds (onnelaLabServer, commStatsCustomUrl); the Google Play build (Beiwe2) has not asked for SMS/MMS or call-log permissions since 2.5.0. Studies set to "production data" restrict downloads to processed output.
note: Phone numbers and Wi-Fi and Bluetooth MAC addresses are hashed on the phone with a per-device key. Power state on iOS is documented inconsistently (profile holds that conflict). Ambient audio: Android 3.1.0 added it; backend defaults are 10 minutes on, 10 minutes off, 44.1 kHz. Whether the BSC permits it is not stated. The Play build also does not prompt for background location (Android 3.1.2). The build split dates from Google's March 2019 policy change.
